3028-729039 PURSUANT TOSECTION 98-33(a) OF THE ZONING RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK TRANSFER AND DISTRIBUTION, made as of the 15t day of May, 2015, ZB by Highline Partners, LLC, a New York limited liability company, with an address at c/o Alf Naman Real Estate Advisors, 526 West 26"h Street, New York, New York 10001 ("Transferor"), and DDG 532 West 20" Street LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with an address at 60 Hudson Street, 18" Floor, New York, New York 10013 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: City of New York, designated as Block 695, Lot 28 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (said real property being hereinafter called the “Granting Parcel"); and WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of the unused floor area and other development rights appurtenant to Granting Parcel; and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 691, Lot 50, as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (said property being hereafter called the “Receiving Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Parcel is a “granting site” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site” as defined in Section 98-- ! 33 of theZoningResolution; and WHEREAS, certain “floor area,” as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Granting Parcel is unused and is available for transfer under Section 98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor has notified the City Planning Commission of New York City (hereinafter, the “CPC") of its intent to transfer 4,039 square feet of floor area, (hereinafter, the “Development Rights") from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel; and WHEREAS, by letter dated January 12, 2010, the New York City Department of City Planning ("DCP") advised the Department of Buildings ("DOB") that the Chairperson of the CPC has certified pursuant to Section 98-61 of the Zoning Resolution that a primary and/or secondary access easement is not required on the Granting Parcel; and Bluck 691LotS0 Block 69S Lot 28 8

WHEREAS, Transferor desires to transfer the Development Rights to the ReceivingLot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows: 1. Transferor hereby grants, transfers, distributes and sets over the Development Rights from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity of the Receiving Parcel (and not for the use or benefit of any other lot or parcel of land).  2. The Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive any consideration paid for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to payment of the cost of improvements before using any part of the same for any other purposes. 3. Transferee covenants that it shall not apply for nor seek or cause the issuance of a building permit by the DOB for any enlargement or development on the Receiving Parcel that would involve use of the Development Rights until it has (i) provided to the DCP certified copies of (a) a Notice of Zoning Lot Restrictions, and (b) a Restrictive Declaration, both in forms satisfactory to the DCP, as recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York for the County of New York, and (ii) notice by the DCP of its receipt of such copies has been given to the DOB. 4. This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights has been executed and delivered by Transferor without any representations, warranty or recourse of any kind. 5. This Transfer of Development Rights shall be recorded by Transferor against the Granting Parcel and Receiving Parcel in the Office of the Register of City of New York, New York County and a copy provided to the CPC in accordance with the provisions of Section 98-33(a) of the Zoning Resolution. 6. Transferor covenants to execute and deliver from time to time,upon request by, and at the expense of any successor in interest, such instruments as are necessary to confirm that the property interest hereby transferred consists of the Development Rights only and does not include fee ownership of land or other ownership interests which would subject the Receiving Parcel, or any successor in interest to Transferee's interest therein, to liability for real estate taxes, water and sewer charges, or other similar governmental or public utility charges applicable to the Transfer Parcel.  7. This instrument may be executed in counterparts, all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument.
